result.text:
PROVIDER PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT
This Provider Participation Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of August 7, 2024 (the
"Effective Date") by and between Northbridge Assurance Company ("Plan") and Northgate Family
Physicians ("Provider").

ARTICLE I - TERM AND TERMINATION
1.1 Initial Term. This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of 5
years, expiring on August 6, 2029.
1.2 Renewal. This Agreement shall not renew automatically. Any extension beyond the initial term requires
a written amendment signed by both parties.
1.3 Termination Without Cause. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon 60 days
prior written notice to the other party.

ARTICLE II - COMPENSATION
2.1 Inpatient Services. Plan shall reimburse Provider for covered acute medical/surgical inpatient services at
a per diem rate of $2,325 per day. Behavioral health inpatient services are reimbursed at $2,025 per day.
2.2 Outpatient Services. Plan shall reimburse Provider for covered general outpatient services at 125% of the
then-current Medicare fee schedule. Emergency department services are reimbursed at 115% of the
Medicare fee schedule.

ARTICLE III - CLAIMS
3.1 Payment of Clean Claims. Plan shall pay each clean claim within 15 days after receipt.
3.2 Timely Filing. Provider shall submit claims within 365 days after the date of service. Claim denials may
be appealed within 270 days of the denial notice.

ARTICLE IV - CREDENTIALING
4.1 Plan shall complete credentialing of Provider's practitioners within 60 days after receipt of a complete
application.

ARTICLE V - GENERAL PROVISIONS
5.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Florida.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 10 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 45 days before pursuing other remedies.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
